name: GS Books Showcase – Book Library, Book Grid & Book Slider for Authors
author: GS Plugins

sections.description:
GS Books Showcase turns your WordPress site into a book library. Add each book once with its cover, description, publication date, ISBN and page count, then show your books anywhere as a grid or slider. Every book gets its own page or popup, so readers can see the details without leaving your books page.

Pick a design in the shortcode builder, see it in the live preview, and paste one shortcode or block.

👉 Live demo · Documentation · Pro features · Pricing · Support

Who it’s for

  • Authors: a books page with every title you’ve written, with links to buy.
  • Publishers: your catalog, organized by category and series.
  • Libraries, schools and book clubs: reading lists and collections.
  • Book bloggers and reviewers: the books you’ve read and reviewed, with ratings.

Why site owners choose GS Books Showcase

  • Made for books: fields for ISBN-10, ISBN-13, publication date, page count, dimensions, e-book file size and download link.
  • Set up in minutes: a dedicated Books menu, a shortcode builder with live preview, and one-click demo data.
  • Looks right on every screen: set columns for desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • Works with your builder: Gutenberg block, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Oxygen and the Newspaper theme.

Free features

  • Grid and slider views with 3 designs.
  • Shortcode builder with live preview: create, edit, clone and delete book shortcodes.
  • Open books in a popup or on a single book page.
  • Book details: cover, description, publication date, ISBN-10, ISBN-13, pages, dimensions, e-book file size and download link.
  • Categories and tags, with labels you can rename.
  • Slider controls: speed, autoplay, delay, loop, pause on hover and items to move.
  • Slider arrow and dot styles.
  • Typography settings for titles, authors, labels and values.
  • Pagination.
  • Unlimited books.
  • Export and import books, plus one-click demo data.
  • Custom book slug, custom CSS and template overrides in your child theme.
  • Translation ready, with every front-end label editable.

Pro features

GS Books Showcase Pro adds:

  • Buy links: bookstore buttons with logos, plus formats (hardcover, paperback, e-book, audiobook) each with its own price and link.
  • Filter view with live search and filters, and a ticker view.
  • 31 more designs, including flip, 3D book, author, widget and PDF designs.
  • PDF books: upload a PDF and show it in a reader on the book page.
  • Authors, genres, series and publishers, with author pages.
  • More book details: translator, co-publisher, ASIN, DOI, LCCN, weight, price, sale price, availability, pre-order, age group, reading level, edition, awards and reading time.
  • Readers’ rating and review for each book.
  • Book gallery and cover variations.
  • Ribbons such as “New” or “Bestseller”.
  • More popup and single book page designs.
  • Import book details from Open Library by ISBN, plus CSV bulk import.
  • Drag-and-drop custom order.
  • Priority email support.

Plans start at $49 per year, with a 7-day money-back guarantee. Compare Pro plans.

How it works

  1. Go to Book Showcase > Add New. Add the title, description and cover, then fill in the publication date, ISBN and other details, and choose a category.
  2. Go to Book Showcase > Shortcode, create a shortcode and pick a view and design. The live preview updates as you change settings.
  3. Copy the shortcode, for example [gs_bookshowcase id=2], into any page or post, or use the GS Books block or widget in your page builder.

Each shortcode has three tabs:

  • General: view, design, link type (popup or single page), columns per device and which details to show.
  • Style: image effects, typography, text alignment, and slider arrows and dots.
  • Query: how many books to show, sorting, and which categories and tags to include or exclude.

Shortcode usage

[gs_bookshowcase id=2]

In a theme file:

<?php echo do_shortcode( '[gs_bookshowcase id=2]' ); ?>

See the documentation for every option.

Support

Free users get help in the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority email support through our help desk. We reply as soon as we can, excluding holidays.

More plugins from GS Plugins

  • GS Logo Slider: client, partner and sponsor logos in sliders, carousels, tickers and grids.
  • Solid Testimonials: customer reviews and quotes in sliders, grids and masonry layouts.
  • GS Team Members: team pages and staff directories with profiles and social links.
  • GS Portfolio: show your work in grid, slider, list and filterable layouts.
  • GS Projects Showcase: case studies with client, dates, value and project links.
  • GS Coaches: coach and trainer profiles with skills and certifications.
  • GS Posts Grid: blog posts in 50+ grid, list and slider styles.
  • GS WooCommerce Products Slider: product sliders and carousels for your shop.
  • GS Variation Swatches: color, image and button swatches for WooCommerce variations.
  • GS WooCommerce Brands: add brands to products with logos, filters and sliders.
  • GS Pinterest Portfolio: embed Pinterest pins and boards.
  • GS YouTube Gallery: YouTube videos, playlists and channels in galleries.
  • PowerUp: redirects, restrictions and admin tools for WordPress.

External services

GS Books Showcase connects to these outside services. Nothing is sent until the step described happens.

Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com)
The book styles load their fonts from Google Fonts on pages that show books, and a font you pick in a shortcode’s Typography settings is loaded the same way. The plugin’s admin pages load the DM Sans font from Google Fonts too. Each request sends the visitor’s IP address and browser details to Google, as any web font request does. No other data is sent. Google Fonts privacy FAQ · Google Terms of Service · Google Privacy Policy

CDN Fonts (fonts.cdnfonts.com)
The Help, GS Plugins Pro and GS Plugins Lite admin pages load the Gotham font from CDN Fonts. Only an administrator viewing those pages makes the request, which sends their IP address and browser details. CDN Fonts (terms and privacy policy linked from their site)

Appsero (api.appsero.com)
Used for optional usage statistics and the deactivation survey. Nothing is sent unless an administrator clicks Allow on the “help make GS Books Showcase even more awesome” notice; after that the site URL, site name, administrator name and email, WordPress, PHP and server versions, number of users, active and inactive plugins, the plugin version and the server IP address are sent, and again when the plugin is deactivated. To find the server IP address, the Appsero library asks icanhazip.com (which sees only the server’s IP address). If an administrator fills in the optional survey when deactivating the plugin, the chosen reason and any comment are sent. Appsero privacy policy · icanhazip

The Open Library and Amazon book imports are part of GS Books Showcase Pro, not this plugin.

Development source

Every minified file in this plugin is built from the readable source included in the download:

  • dev/ holds the source of the admin pages, shortcode builder (Vue), front-end scripts and styles.
  • includes/integrations/assets/ holds the source of the Gutenberg block, Elementor and Divi scripts next to their .min.js files.
  • webpack.mix.js and package.json hold the build setup.

To rebuild: run npm install, then npm run production. Third-party libraries in assets/libs/ (Swiper, Magnific Popup, Select2, Font Awesome, Bootstrap grid, Material Design Iconic Font, date picker) are the unmodified releases from their projects.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for GS Books Showcase.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. A Book Showcase menu appears in your dashboard.

By uploading the zip file

  1. Download gs-books-showcase.zip.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, choose the file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin.

By FTP

  1. Upload the gs-books-showcase folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins in your dashboard.

Then add [gs_bookshowcase id=#] where you want the books to show. See the setup guide for screenshots of each step.
sections.faq:
How do I add a book?

Go to Book Showcase > Add New. Enter the title and description, set the cover as the featured image, fill in the book details and choose a category. Then publish. See Add a new book for a step-by-step guide.

Can I import book details instead of typing them?

You can import books exported from another site using the plugin’s export and import tool. Pro adds two faster ways: fetch a book’s details from Open Library by entering its ISBN, or import many books at once from a CSV file.

How many books can I add?

As many as you need. There is no limit in the free version.

What size should book covers be?

600 × 900 pixels (a 2:3 ratio) works well. Use the same ratio for every cover so the grid lines up.

Can readers buy my books from the showcase?

Yes, with Pro. Add bookstore buttons (Amazon, your own shop or any other store) and formats such as hardcover, paperback and e-book, each with its own price and link.

Can I offer e-book downloads?

Yes. Each book has a download link and file size field. Pro also lets you upload a PDF and show it in a reader on the book page.

Can I group books by author, genre or series?

The free version has categories and tags, which you can rename. Pro adds authors, genres, series and publishers, with author pages.

Can I show ratings and reviews?

Yes, with Pro. Add a readers’ rating and a review to each book.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi and other page builders?

Yes. It has a Gutenberg block and native widgets or modules for Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Oxygen and the Newspaper theme. In any other builder, paste the shortcode.

Why does my book page show a 404 error?

WordPress needs to refresh its links. Go to Settings > Permalinks and click Save once.

How do I use the shortcode in a theme template?

Use <?php echo do_shortcode( '[gs_bookshowcase id=2]' ); ?> and replace 2 with your shortcode’s ID.

What is the difference between the free and Pro versions?

The free version gives you grid and slider views with 3 designs, book pages and popups, the main book details and unlimited books. Pro adds buy links and formats with prices, Open Library and CSV import, filter and ticker views, 31 more designs including 3D and PDF designs, authors, genres and series, ratings, reviews, galleries and priority support. See the Pro features and plans.
